items.title: Reducing database incident MTTR by 73% with a custom AWS DevOps Agent Skill
items.summary: Database incidents routinely take 45 to 60 minutes to triage. This post shows how to build a custom AWS DevOps Agent Skill that encodes expert Aurora PostgreSQL triage into decision-tree logic across five failure modes, cutting mean time to resolution from 52 minutes to 14 minutes (a 73% reduction) in a controlled test.
items.creator: Chetan Suri
